text_block_list.text:
As the Senior Class is finally about to 
begin, as for Hokko Tarumaeâ

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Things just don't go that smoothly, do 
they...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many projections I run, if 
we stick to our current plan, expanding 
our overall fanbase still won't help us 
reach Tomakomai...

We were having a meeting about local idol 
activities right at the start of the year, 
but Hokko Tarumae's expression remained 
somber...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I guess there's no choice but to change my 
way of thinking after all—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer. I have a small proposal.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm thinking of changing our 
direction a bit for future local idol 
activities. To be specific—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of reducing the frequency of 
Tomakomai-centric content... and 
increasing the entertainment-focused 
content that fans enjoy more.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, this wasn't my intention. 
However, it is a fact that many people are 
now paying new attention to me—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Also, current data shows entertainment 
content has a high retention rate for 
newcomers... Very few drop it after their 
first viewing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Even if the traffic to Tomakomai is small 
relative to the total fan population... 
it's still better to have a larger total 
fan base...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So for now, I want to make choices that 
yield reliable results and prepare for the 
breakthrough to come. That is... my 
conclusion at this point in time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What are your thoughts on this, Trainer?

What she says is undoubtedly true. 
Expanding the fan base should indeed bring 
more benefits overall...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! In that case, let me 
review my stream schedule starting 
tomorrow right away!

And so, starting from the New Year, Hokko 
Tarumae shifted her local idol activities 
to focus more on entertainment...

By centering our activities around two-way 
fan interaction like livestreams and live 
shows, the time taken up by local idol 
work swelled—

—As a result, Hokko Tarumae was unable to 
go home for the New Year's holidays...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, let's pack up too! We've got 
to get back to training next!
choice_data_list:
...Are you really sure you don't need to 
go home this year?

...Are you really sure you don't have to 
head home this year?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, I already told you! I'm going to 
give my all doing my activities here over 
New Year's!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'll be fine. My family and the 
folks back in Tomakomai are all supporting 
my way of doing things!

"...The people of Tomakomai are kind. If 
Hokko Tarumae says 'I want to do this,' 
I'm sure they'll support and cheer her 
on."

And Hokko Tarumae never once uttered a 
complaint. As if she didn't feel even the 
slightest bit of loneliness.

Yet, try as I might, beneath the smile 
Hokko Tarumae showed, I couldn't help but 
sense a faint trace of loneliness...
choice_data_list: (I really want to help her out somehow...)

text_block_list.text:
—The next day. Between training and her 
local idol activities, I decided to make a 
certain suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Th-That's so sudden. I mean, it's 
true I haven't had time to go this year, 
but—
choice_data_list: Alright, that settles it. Let's head out!
Alright, that settles it. Let's head out!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What do you mean by that...? Well, 
whatever, but—"

After quickly finishing our New Year's 
shrine visit with Hokko Tarumae—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've finished our Hatsumode visit, 
so shall we head back? We can't afford to 
waste training time either—
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, wanna grab a bite nearby 
before heading home?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be more efficient to eat at 
the academy? The restaurants are probably 
going to get crowded right about now—
choice_data_list: Please, you've gotta make it work...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...? Trainer, you seem a bit unusual 
today...? Did something happen?
choice_data_list: ...There's a shop I'd like to drop by.
...There's a shop I want to check out.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's what it was. You should have 
just told me that from the start.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, shall we go right 
away? If it's a place you want to go to so 
badly, Trainer, I've gotten a little 
curious about it too.

With Hokko Tarumae in tow, I began heading 
toward the shop we were looking for—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No way... Could this place be— A Tomakomai 
Curry Ramen shop...!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The interior looks just like that shop in 
Tomakomai... Wait, it's packed with photos 
and merchandise of me—

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Hokko Tarumae-san!! It's such an 
honor to have you visit us today!! Thank 
you very much too, Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san. What on earth is—

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I wanted to spread Tomakomai's curry 
ramen, so I trained at a shop in Tomakomai 
and opened this place here on the 
mainland!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae-san is our pride and joy! A 
true idol! Please enjoy our curry ramen 
today to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... you looked for a shop for 
me...?
choice_data_list:
I wanted you to feel a little bit of 
Tomakomai

I wanted you to get a little taste of 
Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...This isn't fair.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Curry ramen, a bit on the sweet side, 
please. And also the surf clam gyoza.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... That was delicious... It really 
tasted just like the one back in 
Tomakomai—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for bringing me here. ...It felt 
a little like returning to my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, why don't we 
take a little detour before heading home 
today?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I kinda just felt like taking a break 
today.

Such an unusual suggestion coming from 
Hokko Tarumae made me hesitate for a 
moment. However—

Since I had been wanting to help ease some 
of her tension, this suggestion was a 
godsend...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu— Thank you very much.

A good place to make a detour after this 
would be—

When Hokko Tarumae and I dropped by a cafe 
to take a breather—
—Welcome, wandering traveler.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You folks happen to be our 564th group of 
customers. For your commemorative gift, 
would you prefer mechanical pencil lead or 
disposable chopsticks?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi-san!? What are you doing here!?

The Umamusume who suddenly appeared is 
Gold Ship. Unruly and eccentric as she is, 
her talent is the real deal, and she's one 
of the Umamusume hyping up current turf 
racesâ

Though their main battlegrounds differ so 
they don't run together, they're also 
members of the very same generation as 
Hokko Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Can't ya tell I'm manager for a day as 
thanks for sealin' a rampagin' gargoyle 
behind the shop? Oh, cold hot water is 
self-service, by the way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? A g-gargoyle? Store manager for a 
day...? Cold hot water...? W-What is going 
on...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, the stream just started, 
you know? Do you really think you're gonna 
pull in highlights with comebacks like 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Streaming...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, eeehh?! A camera?! Since when?! Are 
we live right now?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad. I hadn't hit the button yet. 
Alright, time to stream! You better feel 
honored to do a collab stream with 
Golshi-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
“—Gold Ship-san, it's almost time to wrap 
things up.”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it that time already? Guess I'll 
leave my portrait and head home~ Keep the 
change, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
See ya, guys. I recommend the honey ginger 
tea, so you'd better drink it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what that was all about.

Afterward, we spent a relaxing time 
sipping on the recommended honey ginger 
tea...

When Hokko Tarumae and I arrived at a 
nearby zoo—
—It's festival time, a festival, yeehaw!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo! You guys waitin' for rare enemies to 
pop so you can go beyond the sky too? Too 
late. Golshi-chan's already spawn-camped 
'em all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi-san!? What are you doing here!?

The Umamusume who suddenly appeared is 
Gold Ship. Unruly and eccentric as she is, 
her talent is the real deal, and she's one 
of the Umamusume hyping up current turf 
racesâ

Though their main battlegrounds differ so 
they don't run together, they're also 
members of the very same generation as 
Hokko Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't it common sense to have a sidekick 
on an adventure for lost treasure, huh!? 
I'm not handin' over the Golden Giant 
Salamander!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? A-A lost treasure? An 
adventure...? A giant salamander...? 
W-What does all this mean...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, weapons and armor are 
useless if you don't actually equip them, 
you know?! Do you really think you're 
gonna pull in highlights with comebacks 
like that?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Good footage...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, eeehh?! A camera?! Since when?! Are 
we live right now?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad. I hadn't hit the button yet. 
Alright, startin' now! Golshi-chan's 
surprise collab stream is live!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold—

text_block_list.name: PA Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The elephant painting show will begin 
shortly. Those with numbered tickets, 
please—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, can't just stand around! The 
Maestro's once-in-a-lifetime grand 
performance is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
See ya, guys! I totally recommend the sea 
lion show at this zoo.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what that was all about.

Afterward, we checked out the recommended 
sea lion show and enjoyed the zoo, 
spending a relaxing and pleasant time...

When Hokko Tarumae and I arrived at a 
nearby shopping mall—
—Welcome, customer~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Is the one you're looking for the Gold 
Golshi-chan statue? The Silver Golshi-chan 
statue? Or the Adamant Golshi-chan statue?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi-san!? What are you doing here!?

The Umamusume who suddenly appeared is 
Gold Ship. Unruly and eccentric as she is, 
her talent is the real deal, and she's one 
of the Umamusume hyping up current turf 
racesâ

Though their main battlegrounds differ so 
they don't run together, they're also 
members of the very same generation as 
Hokko Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just went with the flow, y'know... I was 
lookin' for some bamboo craft for flowin' 
pasta, but then... I got distracted by a 
metal alloy wallet... and here we are.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Flowing pasta...? An alloy 
wallet...? What in the world are those...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, why are you being so 
laid-back?! The show must go on! Do you 
really think you're gonna rack up comments 
with reads like that?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Comment count...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, eeehh?! A camera?! Since when?! 
Wait, are you streaming this right now?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad. Haven't hit the button yet. 
Let's get this party started! Celebrating 
our collab, the Gol-Mae Channel is off to 
the races, babyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold—

text_block_list.name: PA Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—Paging Gold Ship-sama, Gold Ship-sama. 
Your companion is looking for you. Please 
come to the 1st floor service counter.”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what's up? Mac-chan, are you lost~? 
Guess I gotta help ya out~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
See ya, suckers! The Japanese doll shop on 
the 3rd floor of this mall is totally 
worth a look!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what that was all about.

Afterward, we visited various shops like 
the recommended Japanese doll store, 
spending a relaxing time together...
